function.name: Open
function.desc: shows the dialog with the current name prefilled

param.name: currentName
param.desc: name the load list shows for this save right now

param.name: canReset
param.desc: 1 when the save carries a stashed original name

function.name: Close
function.desc: hides the dialog without emitting an event

function.name: ShowHint
function.desc: shows or hides the F2 prompt drawn over the save list

function.name: SetInput
function.desc: key feed from the plugin's input listener: the engine delivers typed characters to the movie but not Enter or Esc

event.name: OnReset
event.desc: the player asked for the original name back
